The only designated evacuation point is Shivapuri shelter. Dhunche temple is not designated, so dropping people there would not count as a rescue.

- **Kalika farm:** the round trip is 14 minutes and saves 3 adults, who would cost 60 if deferred. I rescue them.
- **Dupcheshwar market:** the round trip is 64 minutes for 1 adult, who costs only 20 if deferred. I defer.
- **Uttargaya farm:** the round trip is at least 110 minutes for 2 adults, who cost 40 if deferred. Even combined with Dupcheshwar, the trip costs more than deferring all 3 (60). I defer.

<plan>
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter kalika-farm
load car1 adult 3
drive car1 kalika-farm shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 adult 3
defer dupcheshwar-market adult 1
defer uttargaya-farm adult 2
</plan>
